This balanced 1:1 formulation promotes a harmonious experience that's both social and focused, while providing gentle relief without overwhelming intensity. Betty's Eddies are crafted for consistency and quality, ensuring each chew delivers a reliable, enjoyable experience. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or enhance your creative pursuits, these strawberry lemonade chews offer a delicious and effective way to find your perfect balance.
